timing: Declared after the primary selection and evaluation results were inspected. This is an explicit post-selection diagnostic, not preregistered confirmation or a fresh holdout.
reason: Independent review identified unequal training exposure in the SOR selection window. Production transferred coefficients were originally fitted on FBS-involving 2014-2019 games. Of 1503 FCS-involving selection games in 2018-2019, 226 FBS-FCS outcomes directly entered that original fit, while 1277 FCS-FCS games contributed graph context. New FCS candidates only used 2014-2017 outcomes before selection. This favors the existing baseline and prevents treating the primary baseline selection as independent proof of superiority.
diagnostic: For each already declared SOR context, fit every existing family (transferred, fcsSlopeHome, fcsAll) on the same declared 2014-2019 refit data, and report each on 2021-2025. Use identical target identities, frozen penalty and metrics. Report paired week-block sensitivity versus transferred. No additional families, penalties, weighting, source changes or searches.
decisionPolicy: Retain the primary selected family and original results unchanged. Do not reselect a model or promote any production change using this diagnostic. It describes candidate sensitivity; an equal-training-cutoff control study and new prospective evidence would be needed to justify a stronger comparative claim.
